messages:
sophie tran: Pushed a tiny docs PR to tidy examples and fix two stale links in the dedicated provisioning page. https://git/repo/pulls/5355
mike rogers: thanks. which links are stale? I can replace them with canonical anchors.
anita bose: one was the old terraform snippet path, other was a badge to legacy autoscale schema. both 404 in prod handbooks.
sophie tran: exact fixes in PR comments. Also added a short UX note about error 400 when legacy fields are sent — suggest pointing users to the compatibility table instead of a long paragraph.
mike rogers: good. Can you add a one-line SDK snippet that shows how to set the new tenant_labels field? Quick copy-paste is all customers want.
anita bose: here's a tiny Python snippet that fits the quickstart:

```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
c.tenants.create(name="acme", tenant_labels={"env":"prod","team":"payments"})
```

sophie tran: added that and noted SDK >=0.10.0. docbot: lint: missing cross-link to /handbook/dedicated/migration.md and add changelog entry.
docbot: also suggest adding a short note under "errors" that explains the 400 -> "legacy field present" case with remediation steps.
mike rogers: good catch. Add remediation: run redwoodctl migrate-tenant --dry-run to preview conversion.
anita bose: added a one-liner CLI example and a rollback pointer to the runbook. staging-bot: staging deploy queued by sophie tran -> docs-staging at 5076543600
sophie tran: can someone smoke test the quickstart snippet after deploy? small tenant on staging should be enough.
mike rogers: I can run it in ~30m. will report back here.
anita bose: editorial nit: replace phrase "may encounter brief downtime" -> "may encounter transient throttling" in the isolation note. legal prefers that.
sophie tran: done. merging after smoke test + one approval. thanks :raised_hands:
mike rogers: smoke test complete: snippet created tenant, no errors. observed ~25s of elevated throttling during label propagation on a 2-node reserved pool. no 5xxs. PASS.
sophie tran: merging and adding changelog entry: "docs: tidy dedicated provisioning links, add SDK/CLI snippets, clarify legacy-field errors" :tada:
